glyph_rationales.0: the non-objectifiable condition present in every act of distinguishing — subject-pole, the singular One, the uncounted; never nothing, never one more object (orienting principles §II)
glyph_rationales.1: whatever has become determinate enough to name, count, model or govern — the mark, the polyvalent All, the object-pole
glyph_rationales./: the differentiating activity itself — division and ratio, AND/OR; the act that makes both positions legible, not punctuation between finished things
glyph_rationales.−: withdrawal — the side that withholds itself from determinate presentation; reserve before value
glyph_rationales.+: extension — the reserve's own issue; affirmation that carries its origin through the difference by which it appears
glyph_rationales.−/−: the bare relation `/ = −/−`: one mark twice placed, no value assigned — relation before named terms, the parent determination
glyph_rationales.0/1: the first orientation: the singular One becoming articulate through the polyvalent All — earned as notation at §1 · #5→0; QL's relational identity `0/1 = 1/0` names both orientations of one relation
glyph_rationales.1/0: the obverse orientation: the achieved determination returning toward the condition it cannot possess — the consequent essence `5→0`, with the arithmetic seam retained
glyph_rationales.?/!: inquiry and naming in one sign — the question has asserted a provisional this, and the assertion carries the question whether it has said truly (#1; second processual placement at #3)
glyph_rationales.IS: first Catuṣkoṭi corner — the appearing belongs to awareness
glyph_rationales.IS-NOT: second corner — awareness is not exhausted by the phenomenon now appearing
glyph_rationales.BOTH: third corner — the appearance belongs to awareness and does not exhaust it; both operations held together
glyph_rationales.NEITHER: fourth corner — the account turned on its own remaining claim; neither identity nor difference encloses the condition of predication
glyph_rationales.SILENCE: the recognition through which the four corners become one lived movement — the asker no longer confused with a final answer
glyph_rationales.X: determining capacity — the field of crossings; the Self's determining fullness presiding through its instances (#3 Pattern)
glyph_rationales.x: the indefinite particular, and multiplication — an instance that can recur and compound; the ego's particular measurement (psyche spine reads X = x)
glyph_rationales.X/x: one letter in two cases — capacity legible through its instances; the slash the activity of determination between them
glyph_rationales.AM: first-person presence — I am; the personed face of the copula
glyph_rationales.AM/IS: the personed copula — the slash as second person: an address that can be answered and alter the account's terms (#4 Context)
glyph_rationales.∞: the unbounded horizon no finite mark contains — the openness encountered before and after determination (Essence fold 0+5)
glyph_rationales.dx: the local differential through which change becomes exact — `F'(x)=2x`, whose integration retains an undetermined constant
glyph_rationales.∞/dx: local precision held in relation to inexhaustible depth — return retaining a difference, one law with the retained `9/8`
glyph_rationales./ = ( = =/≠ ≠ ): the complexio's exact form — the whole determining relation held as identity, identity-related-to-difference and difference in one readable movement (the copula expansion, complexio-oppositorum record)
glyph_rationales.#0: a numbered station — one determination located; the contrast through which the whole relation `#` is followed
glyph_rationales.#5: the sixfold's last station — the same contrast read from the returning end
glyph_rationales.A: the same letter twice placed — self-identity requires two appearances and the relation identifying them
glyph_rationales.=: the identifying bond written as two parallel strokes — identity as active relation (to, for, as, with)
glyph_rationales.≠: equality crossed by the slash — difference as equality under cut; identity retaining the difference through which it is asserted
glyph_rationales.Ø: the crossed zero, introduced §1 · #3 with one job — representation crossing a zero-space it cannot fill; here in its §4 crossing scene only: the slash fused into the zero, computation confused for the computer (occlusion)
glyph_rationales.Ø/X: mediation exposed — the stroke legible as medium between the apparent subject and its object-field
glyph_rationales.(0/Ø): recognition's first side — unobjectifiable presence distinguished from the apparent subject (composite staged as its exact parts)
glyph_rationales.(1/X): recognition's second side — the differentiated field gathered in relation to its affirmed unity
glyph_rationales.−/+: polarity as force — withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue in one sign; the dynamis (#2), `(-1)/(+1)` with zero as axis
